_comment: Registry lifetime verdicts (#11511), enforced by scripts/registry_lifetime_check.py.
One entry per map-like static with NO production removal path. An unlisted such registry FAILS,
and so does an entry that matches nothing: a fix (a removal path, or deleting the table) deletes its entry.
`open_leak` entries are real unbounded tables, named so the debt is visible; each is a follow-up to fix.

registries.name: CLIENT_REQUEST_SURFACE
registries.why: Keyed by ClientRequest handle, one entry per outgoing request via with_state_mut's entry().or_default(); destroy() only flips `destroyed`, nothing removes the key

registries.name: CONFIGS
registries.why: Keyed by a hash of the TLS option identity (verifier/CA/client cert): one rustls config per distinct option set, not per request

registries.name: PENDING
registries.why: Keyed by runtime server handle; take_pending only pop_fronts the VecDeque, so an empty queue entry stays for every server ever created

registries.name: PENDING
registries.why: Keyed by runtime server handle; take_pending pops the deque but never removes the key, leaving one entry per created server after close

registries.name: MAP
registries.why: Keyed by per-instance id from js_net_block_list_new: one entry per new BlockList(), and no production path removes it

registries.name: MAP
registries.why: Keyed by per-instance handle: one SocketAddressState per new SocketAddress, production only inserts/reads

registries.name: TRANSFORM_PAIRS
registries.why: writable_id -> transform_id, inserted per TransformStream creation; production only reads it, never removes

registries.name: TRANSFORM_STREAMS
registries.why: Keyed by NEXT_TS_ID, one entry per new TransformStream; removed only in test code, so its callbacks stay rooted forever

registries.name: WRITABLE_STREAMS
registries.why: Keyed by NEXT_WS_ID per WritableStream (and a transform's writable side); the only .remove() is in the #[cfg(test)] module

registries.name: WRITERS
registries.why: Keyed by NEXT_WRITER_ID per getWriter(); releaseLock only sets locked=false and the only remove is in #[cfg(test)]

registries.name: HANDLE_GENERATIONS
registries.why: Keyed by AsyncLocalStorage handle; bumped on disable() while active and never dropped by remove_store, so it grows per such ALS instance

registries.name: ASYNC_HOOK_HANDLES
registries.why: Set of AsyncHook handles, one per createHook(); disable() does not remove and nothing else does

registries.name: ASYNC_RESOURCE_HANDLES
registries.why: Set of Box::into_raw AsyncResource handles, one per new AsyncResource; documented as monotonic and never shrunk

registries.name: ASYMMETRIC_KEY_REGISTRY
registries.why: Keyed by the address of a PEM-string KeyObject per createPublic/PrivateKey; finalize_collected_dead_buffer clears the other crypto tables but not this one

registries.name: OVERRIDES
registries.why: Keyed by closure func_ptr (a code address, not a closure instance): at most one entry per compiled function

registries.name: OVERRIDES
registries.why: Keyed by func_ptr code address via js_register_function_source; last write wins, one slot per compiled function

registries.name: REGISTRY
registries.why: Keyed by compiled function code pointer, written by codegen module init via js_register_function_name_static once per function

registries.name: REGISTRY
registries.why: Keyed by compiled func_ptr, populated from module init by js_register_function_source_static once per function body

registries.name: MATERIALIZED
registries.why: Keyed by $perryfs virtual path of a library embedded in the binary: one temp file per embedded library

registries.name: SINGLETON_CLOSURES
registries.why: Keyed by func_ptr of non-capturing closures: one cached closure per compiled function

registries.name: CLOSURE_BODY_REGISTRY
registries.why: One ClosureBodyRecord per closure body keyed by func_ptr, filled at module init from codegen registrations

registries.name: MEMBER_KEY_CACHE
registries.why: Property-name -> key cache written only under the PERRY_DYN_FAST_SCOPE toggle (default off); grows per distinct name, uncapped when on

registries.name: ENV_KEY_CACHE
registries.why: Identifier name -> longlived key string, capped at ENV_KEY_CACHE_MAX=4096; past the cap it falls back to uncached GC keys

registries.name: SOURCE_FN_CACHE
registries.why: new Function source -> InterpFn id, capped at SOURCE_FN_CACHE_MAX=4096 entries / 32MB; later distinct sources are not memoized

registries.name: INTERNED_ERROR_CODES
registries.why: Interns Node ERR_* code strings to leaked &'static str for the .code getter: one entry per distinct code, not per error

registries.name: WRITER_REGISTRY
registries.why: Keyed by NEXT_WRITER_ID per FileHandle writer; close/end only set state.closed=true and the entry (with its rooted handle) stays

registries.name: PRIMITIVE_DISPATCH
registries.why: Primitive-method fallback histogram, written only when gc_diag_enabled() (PERRY_GC_DIAG) and printed at exit

registries.name: SHAPE_LAYOUTS
registries.why: Keyed by ShapeId, one entry per distinct shape shared by all its objects; never removed by design (O(shapes), not O(objects))

registries.name: LAYOUT_SLOT_MASKS
registries.why: Per-object masks are removed through the hot-TLS raw pointer (hot_layout_slot_masks), which the name walk cannot follow; also pruned per GC

registries.name: TYPED_LAYOUTS
registries.why: Per-object descriptors are removed through the hot-TLS raw pointer (hot_typed_layouts), which the name walk cannot follow; also pruned per GC

registries.name: CANONICAL_MODULE_DIRS
registries.why: Memo of canonicalized directories holding module paths; bounded by the directories the program resolves

registries.name: CANONICAL_MODULE_PATHS
registries.why: Realpath memo keyed by module path from registration/require resolution; bounded by the program's module files

registries.name: PATH_MODULE_INIT_ADDRS
registries.why: Canonical module path -> compiled initializer address, set at perry_module_init once per compiled module

registries.name: RECOVERABLE_ERRORS
registries.why: HashSet of ErrorHeader addresses, one per new repl.Recoverable; never removed, so it grows and keeps stale addresses

registries.name: FILE_BLOBS
registries.why: One entry per file-backed Blob under a fresh NEXT_FILE_BLOB_ID; nothing removes it, even after the blob dies

registries.name: FILE_BLOB_STREAMS
registries.why: One entry per blob stream under a fresh id; next/return/cancel only set consumed=true

registries.name: DIAG_TRACES
registries.why: A fresh next_diag_id() entry per tracingChannel() call (even for the same name), holding a rooted object; never removed

registries.name: DIAG_BOUNDED_CHANNELS
registries.why: A fresh next_diag_id() entry per bounded-channel creation, holding a rooted object; never removed

registries.name: DIAG_STORE_SCOPES
registries.why: A new scope id per withStoreScope call; dispose only sets disposed=true and never removes the entry

registries.name: DEFAULT_OBJECT_SINGLETONS
registries.why: Keyed by the &'static builtin submodule key: one cached default object per builtin submodule

registries.name: EXPORT_SINGLETONS
registries.why: Keyed by (&'static submodule key, &'static export name) of builtin node submodules: a fixed set of builtin exports

registries.name: NAMESPACE_SINGLETONS
registries.why: Keyed by the &'static builtin submodule key: one namespace object per builtin submodule on first use

registries.name: TRACE_STATES
registries.why: Keyed by NEXT_TRACE_ID, one TraceState per trace_events.createTracing() call; enable/disable only toggle state, nothing removes it

registries.name: KINDS
registries.why: Attribute census counters, compiled only with the attr-census feature and armed by PERRY_ATTR_DIAG

registries.name: CLASS_CAPTURE_VALUES
registries.why: Keyed by codegen class_id from js_class_register_capture_values at the declaration site; re-runs overwrite

registries.name: CLASS_ENVS
registries.why: Keyed by compiled class id, registered from codegen module-init FFI: one entry per capturing class

registries.name: CLASS_GENERIC_ORIGIN
registries.why: Monomorphized specialization class_id -> generic class_id, emitted by codegen

registries.name: CLASS_HAS_INSTANCE_REGISTRY
registries.why: class_id -> lifted __perry_wk_hasinstance_<class> fn ptr, registered at module init once per class

registries.name: CLASS_REGISTRY
registries.why: class_id -> parent edges from class declarations; synthetic ids (util.inherits) are per distinct constructor, not per instance

registries.name: CLASS_TO_STRING_TAG_REGISTRY
registries.why: class_id -> lifted __perry_wk_tostringtag_<class> getter, registered at module init once per class

registries.name: FETCH_PARENT_KIND
registries.why: class_id -> 1/2 only for classes extending the global Request/Response, registered once per class

registries.name: CLASS_LENGTHS
registries.why: class_id -> constructor length, written only by codegen registration; last write wins

registries.name: CLASS_NAMES
registries.why: Keyed by codegen class_id via js_register_class_name (plus a few builtin ids): one entry per declared class

registries.name: REGISTRY
registries.why: class_id -> source text from codegen js_register_class_source: one entry per class declaration site

registries.name: CLASS_DECLARED_STATIC_GLOBAL_SLOTS
registries.why: (class_id, declared static field name) -> LLVM global address, registered by codegen

registries.name: CLASS_DYNAMIC_PARENT_VALUE
registries.why: Child class_id -> parent ctor bits stored at class-definition time; overwritten on re-evaluation

registries.name: CLASS_METHOD_BIND_LENGTHS
registries.why: (class_id, method name) -> spec .length, written only at codegen method registration

registries.name: CLASS_OBJECT_VALUES
registries.why: Template class_id -> latest per-evaluation class object bits; last-wins, one slot per declaration site

registries.name: CLASS_PARENT_CLOSURES
registries.why: Keyed by the child's declared class_id from js_register_class_parent_dynamic; last-wins per declaration

registries.name: CLASS_PROTOTYPE_OBJECTS
registries.why: Also keyed by synthetic class ids minted per closure value (new F() / F.prototype=), so per-evaluation closures grow it forever

registries.name: CLASS_STATIC_METHOD_BIND_LENGTHS
registries.why: (class_id, static method name) -> .length, written only at codegen static-method registration

registries.name: CLASS_SYMBOL_MEMBER_ORDERS
registries.why: Key includes the runtime SymbolHeader.id: a re-evaluated class expression with computed [Symbol()] members adds entries each time

registries.name: VERDICT_CLASSES
registries.why: Receiver class ids from packed_add store verdicts, including synthetic ids minted per closure; never pruned (small u32s)

registries.name: DECLARED_FIELD_NAME_HASHES
registries.why: FNV hashes of declared instance-field names harvested at class registration; bounded by source field names

registries.name: PROTO_DESCRIPTOR_KEY_HASHES
registries.why: Hashes of keys defineProperty'd onto prototype-level targets: per distinct key name, not per operation

registries.name: PRIVATE_NAME_INTERNER
registries.why: Interns #private name spellings, which are compile-time literals per access site: one per distinct name

registries.name: CLASS_PROTOTYPE_METHOD_VALUES
registries.why: (class_id, method name) -> bound method closure cache, filled only for vtable-registered methods

registries.name: NATIVE_CALLABLE_EXPORTS
registries.why: "module\0export" -> bound native closure, gated by is_native_module_callable_export: a fixed builtin set

registries.name: NATIVE_ESM_EXPORT_VALUES
registries.why: Keyed by module\0property of builtin exports the program imports; syncBuiltinESMExports refreshes existing keys only

registries.name: NATIVE_MODULE_ACCESSOR_EXPORTS
registries.why: Keys are fs\0get|set\0{ReadStream,WriteStream,...,promises} from nm_get_own_descriptor: about 11 fixed entries

registries.name: NATIVE_MODULE_NAMESPACES
registries.why: Keyed by builtin module name (plus a few fixed entries): one cached namespace object per builtin

registries.name: NATIVE_NAMESPACE_PROP_OVERRIDES
registries.why: Keyed by module\0prop for user writes to builtin namespace members; repeat writes replace, so per distinct name

registries.name: CLASS_METHOD_NAME_INTERNER
registries.why: Keyed by (class_id, declared method name); leaked name bytes must stay stable and re-evaluation adds no keys

registries.name: SOURCE_MAP_CACHE
registries.why: module.findSourceMap cache keyed by canonical filename: once per distinct file with an inline map, not per call

registries.name: SITE_TEST_HEADERS
registries.why: Keyed by compiler-emitted regex call-site keys: one cached header per source site

registries.name: SHARED_SAB_REGISTRY
registries.why: One address per SharedArrayBuffer backing; mirrors the deliberately never-freed backings (#4913), so it grows per SAB created

registries.name: STATIC_PLUGINS
registries.why: Keyed by the source path of each bundled extension, registered once from entry-module init

registries.name: SEEN
registries.why: HashSet of &'static FFI stub symbol names for first-call warnings: the fixed set of stubs in the runtime

registries.name: REGISTERED_SYMBOL_DESCRIPTIONS
registries.why: Keyed by each leaked Symbol.for / well-known symbol; tracks the registries above per distinct key

registries.name: SYMBOL_REGISTRY
registries.why: Symbol.for(key) registry: by spec it returns the same symbol forever; grows per distinct key string

registries.name: WELL_KNOWN_SYMBOLS
registries.why: Keyed by well-known symbol short names (iterator, toPrimitive, ...): about 15 fixed spec names

registries.name: CLAIM_LOCK
registries.why: Keyed by thread-local declaration name across provider images; inserts stop at HOT_SLOT_CAPACITY (SLOT_OVERFLOW)

registries.name: NAVSTACK_REGISTRY
registries.why: Keyed by compiler-synthesized NavStack state id, registered per declared route during UI init

registries.name: WASM_IMPORT_OBJECTS
registries.why: Keyed by a monotonic token per WebAssembly instantiation; each keeps its imports object rooted and none is removed

registries.name: CONTAINER_HANDLES
registries.why: Keyed by NEXT_HANDLE_ID, one entry per register_container_handle call; nothing reads or removes it

registries.name: CONTAINER_INFO_LIST_REGISTRY
registries.why: A fresh handle id per list/ps result; no take/remove exists, so every query leaks its Vec<ContainerInfo>

registries.name: CONTAINER_INFO_REGISTRY
registries.why: A fresh NEXT_HANDLE_ID per inspect result via register_container_info; nothing removes entries

registries.name: CONTAINER_LOGS_REGISTRY
registries.why: A fresh handle id per logs call with no removal path: every logs fetch leaks its ContainerLogs

registries.name: IMAGE_INFO_LIST_REGISTRY
registries.why: A fresh handle id per images query via register_image_info_list; nothing removes entries

registries.name: NAMES
registries.why: Keyed by runtime TLS server handle; take_original_servername only pop_fronts the deque, the key stays after close

registries.name: UNCLONEABLE_OBJECTS
registries.why: Object bits per markAsUncloneable call; never removed, and moved/freed objects leave stale keys

registries.name: UNTRANSFERABLE_OBJECTS
registries.why: NaN-box bits of each object passed to markAsUntransferable: one per marked object, never unmarked

registries.name: PARAMS
registries.why: WASI-only per-thread memo keyed by a wasm function-table index (a function pointer, never a heap address): one entry per distinct compiled closure body ever called, so growth stops at the program's function count
